name: GET /api/leadflow/routing/config - the rule set
description:
The local routing rules, which are the tenant's PREFERENCE, alongside whether sdk-assignment — which makes the actual decision — could be reached. Reporting both, and which of them answered, is what lets an operator tell "my rule did not match" from "the assignment service never saw it".

A REAL BUG WAS FOUND HERE by the live probe: the query used invented column names (priority, conditions, target_user_id) where the schema has evaluation_order, source_channel and assigned_user_id, and returned a 500 on every call. It is now written against the schema and aliased to the client contract, so renaming the table cannot silently break the screen.

NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
